تخترقين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِقِينَ (taḵtariqīna) /tax.ta.ri.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# تُخْتَرَقِينَ (tuḵtaraqīna) /tux.ta.ra.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
